messages:
maya: Hey support — we're running a live demo for a potential enterprise and the customer (acct_8f3b2) is getting 429s from the embeddings endpoint during a short spike. Need a temporary bridge so the demo doesn't fail and a clear path to upgrade.

maya: Repro/quick details: spike started ~2026-03-16T19:02Z, ~350 requests/min sustained for ~90s. First 429 seen at 19:03:05 UTC. Sample curl and response headers below.

maya: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["hello world"]}'
```

maya: Response (trimmed):
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 60
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1976543265
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"You exceeded your free-plan quota"}

sam: thanks for the details — can you paste the customer email/console id and the exact 5‑minute window numbers? free plan default is 60rpm for embeddings, so this spike explains the 429s.

maya: customer console id: acct_8f3b2, email: demo+alpha@cust.example.com. Usage in 19:00–19:05 window: 1,120 requests (embedding batch sizes varied).

raja: ops-oncall here — we can provision a short trial burst. Policy: support can grant a temporary "demo-boost" up to 3x base RPM for up to 48h for sales-verified demos. Need sales approval and an internal ticket.

carol-sales: I can approve if the customer is on a qualifying enterprise path. @maya please confirm they are evaluating a paid plan and share meeting time; I can attach a promo and approve a 48h trial boost.

jon: repro notes — when you hit the 429s also check client retry/backoff. Our runtime returns x-rate-limit-reset (epoch) so client can back off until reset. If you want to simulate locally: hammer with ab or hey, watch response headers.

billing-bot: Created support ticket SUP-3245 for acct_8f3b2 (tag: trial-topup). Assigned to raja.

raja: Next steps: 1) sales confirm (carol) -> 2) ops applies boost -> 3) monitor metrics for latency/regressions and revert at end. I can apply now if carol says go. Command we run: `support-cli grant-burst acct_8f3b2 --rpm 180 --duration 48h --reason "demo spike"`

carol-sales: Approved — customer is qualifying. Maya, please confirm you want this started immediately. I'll own the follow-up to convert to paid.

maya: Please start now. Confirmed customer is on call and wants to continue the demo.

raja: Done — applied demo-boost (rpm=180, 48h). Monitor: requests should succeed now, but recommend client-side 429 handling in case of subsequent bursts. I've added a note to SUP-3245.

sam: Closing loop: support action = temporary burst applied; sales to own post-demo conversion and decide on reserved capacity/Dedicated if throughput needed. Maya — please paste any failed request IDs here if you still see errors and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

maya: Verified — requests are succeeding now. Thanks all.

carol-sales: I'll reach out to the customer after the demo to present upgrade options and a short-term promo to bridge to paid.

raja: Marking this as in-progress until the ticket is closed. If the customer needs permanent higher throughput, recommend Dedicated/reserved capacity conversation.

maya: noted, thanks everyone!
